```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(dplyr)

helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(getwd(), "helpers_workflow.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "inst", "scripts", "helpers_workflow.R"),
  system.file("scripts", "helpers_workflow.R", package = "metpipe")
)
helper_candidates <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)]
if (length(helper_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot locate shared helper script helpers_workflow.R")
}
source(helper_candidates[[1]], local = TRUE)

metpipe_runtime <- wf_load_metpipe_runtime()

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

is_blank <- wf_is_blank
require_path <- wf_require_path
join_path <- wf_join_path

```


```{r}
# Global input

path_raw = params$path_raw
path_result = params$path_result
path_workflow = params$path_workflow
path_mzmine = params$path_mzmine
path_temp = params$path_temp
author = params$author
qc_types = params$qc_types

path_raw <- require_path(path_raw, "path_raw")
path_workflow <- require_path(path_workflow, "path_workflow")

if (is_blank(path_result)) stop("path_result is required")
path_result <- normalizePath(path_result, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(path_result)) dir.create(path_result, recursive = TRUE)

if (is_blank(path_temp)) {
  path_temp <- tempdir()
} else {
  path_temp <- normalizePath(path_temp, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path_temp)) dir.create(path_temp, recursive = TRUE)
}

if (length(qc_types) == 1 && grepl(",", qc_types, fixed = TRUE)) {
  qc_types <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(qc_types, ",", fixed = TRUE)))
}
if (length(qc_types) == 1 && !nzchar(qc_types)) {
  qc_types <- c("BL", "NIST", "PO", "sol", "CP", "IQ", "BPL", "MMix", "PB",
                "SP0625", "SP1125", "SP25", "SP5", "SP10", "SP", "SP40", "POJ", "POK")
}

if (is_blank(author)) {
  author <- "CBMR Metabolomics Platform"
}

```

```{r}
# Workflow selection

path_method_cfg <- file.path(path_workflow, "parameters", "method_configuration.rds")
if (!file.exists(path_method_cfg)) {
  stop("Cannot find method configuration file: ", path_method_cfg)
}

method_all <- readRDS(path_method_cfg)

method_name <- basename(path_raw)
method_tokens <- unlist(strsplit(method_name, "_"))
if (length(method_tokens) < 3) {
  stop("path_raw basename must follow MATRIX_ASSAY_ANALYSIS naming. Got: ", method_name)
}

matrix_i <- method_tokens[1]
assay_i <- method_tokens[2]
analysis_i <- method_tokens[3]

method <- subset(method_all, assay == assay_i & analysis == analysis_i)
if (nrow(method) == 0) {
  stop("No method configuration found for assay=", assay_i, " and analysis=", analysis_i)
}
if (nrow(method) > 1) {
  stop("Multiple method configurations found for assay=", assay_i, " and analysis=", analysis_i)
}

```


```{r}
# Raw data files

path_files_pos <- paste0(path_raw, "/pos/")
path_files_neg <- paste0(path_raw, "/neg/")

run.pos <- FALSE
run.neg <- FALSE
raw_files_pos <- NULL
raw_files_neg <- NULL
meta_pos <- NULL
meta_neg <- NULL

if (analysis_i %in% c("FPASEF")){
  pasef_as_dda <- TRUE
} else {
  pasef_as_dda <- FALSE
}

if (dir.exists(path_files_pos)){
  raw_files_pos <- sort(list.files(path_files_pos, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.(d|mzML)$", ignore.case = TRUE))
  run.pos <- length(raw_files_pos) > 0
}

if (run.pos) {
  meta_pos <- 
    map_standard_name_to_meta(raw_files_pos,
                              qc_types = qc_types,
                              pasef_as_dda = pasef_as_dda) 
}

if (dir.exists(path_files_neg)){
  raw_files_neg <- sort(list.files(path_files_neg, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.(d|mzML)$", ignore.case = TRUE))
  run.neg <- length(raw_files_neg) > 0
}

if (run.neg) {
  meta_neg <- 
    map_standard_name_to_meta(raw_files_neg,
                              qc_types = qc_types,
                              pasef_as_dda = pasef_as_dda) 
}

if (!run.pos && !run.neg) {
  stop("No raw files found in pos/ or neg/ under path_raw: ", path_raw)
}


```

```{r}
# mzmine input

mzmine_params <- join_path(path_workflow, method$mzmine_params)
if (is.na(mzmine_params) || !file.exists(mzmine_params)) {
  stop("Cannot find MZmine parameter file: ", mzmine_params)
}

path_lib_istd_pos <- join_path(path_workflow, method$path_lib_istd_pos)
path_lib_istd_neg <- join_path(path_workflow, method$path_lib_istd_neg)
# path_lib_pos <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_pos), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_pos), NA)
# path_lib_neg <- ifelse(!is.na(method$path_lib_neg), paste0(path_workflow, method$path_lib_neg), NA)
spectral_lib <- strsplit(method$path_spectral, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
path_spectral_lib <- vapply(spectral_lib, function(s) join_path(path_workflow, s), character(1))
mzmine_user <- file.path(path_workflow, "parameters", "qiangao.mzuser")
mzmine_memory <- "-memory none"
mzmine_threads <- "-threads 10"
```


```{r}
# QC

figure_height = 800
figure_width = 1000

```


```{r}
# Post processing
## Clean peaktable

mean.filter <- list(c( 2, "BL", "<", "PO"),
                   c( 1, "Sample", ">", 500))
rsd.filter <- list(c(1, "PO", "<", 0.3))
rt.range <- c(0, 30)
filter_by_missing_feature_pct <- 50
filter_by_missing_sample_type <- "Sample"
outliers.sample <- c()
clean.po.sample.to.use <- "PO"

```


```{r}
## Normalization

impute.method.sample <- "HF"
impute.method.is <- "HF"
norm.po.sample.to.use <- "PO"
norm.method <- c("bestis", "low_cv", "sum", "median")
sample.type.keep <- c("Sample", "PO", "NIST")

```


```{r}
## Merge and map info

final.norm <- "bestis"
final.eval.sample.to.use <- "PO"
final.sample.type.keep <- c("PO", "NIST")
```


```{r}
## Remove theoretical lipids

if (assay_i %in% c("LIPS", "LIPL")){
  extra_processing_lip <- "Y"
} else {
  extra_processing_lip <- "N"
}

```

```{r}
## Others

mzmine_peaktable_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/pos/pos_full_feature_table.csv")
mzmine_peaktable_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/neg/neg_full_feature_table.csv")
path_peaktable_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_pos.xlsx")
path_peaktable_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_neg.xlsx")
path_peaktable_istd_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_istd_pos.xlsx")
path_peaktable_istd_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/peaktable_istd_neg.xlsx")
if (!dir.exists(paste0(path_result, "/data"))) dir.create(paste0(path_result, "/data"))
rds_qc_is_pos <- paste0(path_result, "/data/QC_IS_pos.rds")
rds_qc_is_neg <- paste0(path_result, "/data/QC_IS_neg.rds")
rds_datalist <- paste0(path_result, "/datalist.rds")
path_datatable <- paste0(path_result, "/datatable.xlsx")
```

## Default parameters for processing workflow
```{r}

config <- list(
  path_raw = path_raw,
  path_result = path_result,
  mzmine_params = mzmine_params, 
  mzmine_threads = mzmine_threads,
  path_lib_istd_pos = path_lib_istd_pos, 
  path_lib_istd_neg = path_lib_istd_neg,  
  path_spectral_lib = path_spectral_lib,  
  
  mean.filter = mean.filter,
  rsd.filter = rsd.filter,
  rt.range = rt.range,
  filter_by_missing_feature_pct = filter_by_missing_feature_pct,
  filter_by_missing_sample_type = filter_by_missing_sample_type,
  outliers.sample = outliers.sample,
  clean.po.sample.to.use = clean.po.sample.to.use,
  
  impute.method.sample = impute.method.sample,
  impute.method.is = impute.method.is,
  norm.po.sample.to.use = norm.po.sample.to.use,
  norm.method = norm.method,
  sample.type.keep = sample.type.keep,
  
  final.norm = final.norm,
  final.eval.sample.to.use = final.eval.sample.to.use,
  final.sample.type.keep = final.sample.type.keep,  
  
  extra_processing_lip = extra_processing_lip,
  
  raw_files_pos = raw_files_pos,
  meta_pos = meta_pos,
  raw_files_neg = raw_files_neg,
  meta_neg = meta_neg,
  
  path_workflow = path_workflow,
  path_mzmine = path_mzmine,
  path_temp = path_temp,
  author = author,
  method_name = method_name,
  run.pos = run.pos,
  run.neg = run.neg,  
  # path_lib_pos = path_lib_pos,
  # path_lib_neg = path_lib_neg,
  # spectral_lib = spectral_lib,
  mzmine_user = mzmine_user,
  mzmine_memory = mzmine_memory,
  mzmine_peaktable_pos = mzmine_peaktable_pos,
  mzmine_peaktable_neg = mzmine_peaktable_neg,
  path_peaktable_pos = path_peaktable_pos,
  path_peaktable_neg = path_peaktable_neg,
  path_peaktable_istd_pos = path_peaktable_istd_pos,
  path_peaktable_istd_neg = path_peaktable_istd_neg,
  
  figure_height = figure_height,
  figure_width = figure_width,  
  
  rds_qc_is_pos = rds_qc_is_pos,
  rds_qc_is_neg = rds_qc_is_neg,
  rds_datalist = rds_datalist,
  path_datatable = path_datatable
)

yaml_str <- as.yaml(config)
cat(yaml_str)
writeLines(yaml_str, file.path(path_result, "config.yml"))
```
